metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD + custom Lucia ped (GTA V Legacy)
metadata.description:
GTA VI-Inspired HUD + custom Lucia ped for GTA V LEGACY (the original PC version, GTA5.exe). By FBICat. Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Some HUD art is taken from Rockstar's official GTA VI media and belongs to Rockstar Games. No GTA VI game files are included.
INSTALL - two packages, both to the mods folder 1. This package (the files). 2. GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-RegisterPatch.oiv: registers the HUD's DLC packs in dlclist.xml and raises the gameconfig.xml pools. If step 2 is missing, the HUD tells you in game what is not registered. ViMinimap.asi must end up next to GTA5.exe; the minimap needs it to draw in fullscreen.
What it installs - HUD: scripts\GTA6Hud.dll + scripts\Hud\ (art, sounds, data) + scripts\GTA6Hud.ini - dlcpacks:/vihudfonts/ pause menu, HUD art and fonts, vehicle maker emblems - dlcpacks:/vihudanims/ body carry / loot animations - dlcpacks:/luciaped/ Lucia as a 4th character - dlcpacks:/luciaolf/ the GTA Online female wardrobe and hairstyles for her - 3D minimap: scripts\ViMinimap.dll + MiniMap.* data + ViMinimap.asi (in-game drawing) - 2.5 features (separate scripts; GTA6Hud.dll is FBICat's, unchanged): scripts\ViExtras.dll + scripts\ViExtras\ + ViExtras.ini honor, crosshair, focus, skills, NPC memory, crash cam, binoculars, radio, nitrous, wanted stars and box, police lights scripts\ViWasted.dll + ViWasted.ini WASTED / BUSTED scripts\ViCustoms.dll + scripts\ViCustoms\ + ViCustoms.ini Leonida Customs (GPL-3) scripts\ViCrouch.dll + scripts\ViCrouch\ + ViCrouch.ini crouch and crawl (GPL-3) - No music: put your own mp3/wav files in scripts\Hud\Music and scripts\Hud\Radio\CustomMusic
Changes in 2.5 (full list: CHANGELOG.md on GitHub) - Ported from the FiveM version: WASTED / BUSTED, honor, crosshair and kill marks, Focus, skills and gym, NPC memory, the FiveM crash cam, binoculars and radio, nitrous (hold Left Alt in a car with a bottle), Leonida Customs (drive into an LS Customs garage), crouch (Left Ctrl twice) and crawl (Right Ctrl), the four-state wanted stars and wanted box, and directional police lights. - Fixed: Legacy black screen after dying; wanted box flickering; a crash while driving (traffic variety is off). - Lucia is no longer lent to the story characters near mission markers ([Lucia] MissionRange = 0). - Legacy: a lighter Lucia ped pack, so she no longer crashes outdoors while the world streams in.
Requirements (not included): Script Hook V, Script Hook V .NET 3, OpenIV with the mods folder (OpenIV.asi).
Known conflicts - Other add-on ped packs (AddonPeds, arthurmichael, big ped packs) and large map/arena packs use up the same game limits; if the game crashes (especially when switching to Lucia), disable those first. Known conflict: MzbArena. - Your progress lives in scripts\Hud\Save and is never touched by the package. - Problems: scripts\GTA6Hud.perf.log, scripts\GTA6Hud.error.log and scripts\MiniMap.log say what went wrong.
https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
metadata.licence: Personal use. By FBICat. Contains art cut from Rockstar's official GTA VI media (property of Rockstar Games) and the Grand Figma Kit VI (CC BY 4.0). Minimap based on "GTA VI MiniMap (3D Buildings)" by moddims. 2.5 ports from GTA-VI-UI-and-HUD-for-FiveM by Geckomacabre: ViCustoms.dll, ViCrouch.dll and ViWasted.dll are GPL-3 (source on GitHub, licence beside them); the radio code is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (scripts\ViExtras\Radio\LICENSE.md); Anton font by Vernon Adams, SIL OFL 1.1.
